metadata.title: PreDSH: Preparation for Studies and DSH-Exam
metadata.classification_notes: Describes the PreDSH preparatory program for studies and the DSH exam. Student-facing preparatory offering linked to language and foundation pathways, but not a degree program itself.

content.full_text: HTW Berlin - University of Applied Sciences - studies, research, further education International Pathways to HTW Berlin HTW Foundation PreDSH: Preparation for Studies and DSH-Exam PreDSH: Preparation for Studies and DSH-Exam At a glance final exam German Language Examination for University Entrance (DSH) course duration 20 weeks (= 10 weeks of German C1, then 2 weeks of vacation, then 10 weeks of German & DSH preparation) start summer and winter (early April and early October) teaching language German requirements university entrance qualification recognised in Germany university entrance qualification recognised in Germany (subject-restricted) We are happy to review your documents, provide feedback, and help you find the best options for you. language requirements Proof of German language skills at level B2, e.g. Goethe B2, telc B2, DSH1, TestDaF 3333, proof of more than 800 teaching units course content 20 teaching units German C1 and DSH-exam preparation/week 4 teaching units study skills/week further information information sheet HTW Foundation Programme (PDF) suitable degree programmes at HTW Berlin German-taught BA study programmes at HTW Berlin German-taught MA study programmes at HTW Berlin application via HTW Foundation-application form winter semester: by 15 June summer semester: by 15 January fee 2,580 € Online Consultation Request online consultation now!
